newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo bourse says suspends system-traded issues.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo bourse says suspends system-traded issues.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Friday it was temporarily suspending trading of system-traded stocks, convertible bonds and warrants due to technical problems in an electronic trading system.
A TSE spokesman said the exchange did not know when the system would be restored.
The bourse said in a statement that 1,702 issues were affected by the system problems.
Floor trading on the bourse was not affected.
A total of 150 issues are floor-traded.
